add.k: The priest who beat Rahne and called her a witch
st: Back from the dead as a vision, Reverend Craig hunts Rahne, who killed him, and burns her before he fades.

files.notes: Named in dialogue: Rahne says 'I went to Reverend Craig... And what did Reverend Craig do? Beat me about half to death. Said I was a witch' (transcript the-new-mutants). The surname Sinclair is never said, so n is 'Reverend Craig'. He is already dead (Rahne: 'You're not real. I killed you.' / 'And like Christ, I rise again.'); his vision cries 'Witch! I'll flay the flesh from your bones!' and later attacks her, leaving her burned ('How's the pain?' 'Drugs are helping.' 'Was it really him? Preacher?'). The transcript shows one attack mid-film, not a climax fight, and no clear on-screen defeat, so the step says he fades. No church or parish named: Independent.

add.k: A TV news reporter who covers mutant affairs
st: In season 5, Trish Tilby reports for WJVK on mutant uprisings around the world and on Xavier's plea for peace.
In season 1, Trish interviews Scott and visits Hank to make amends, until Bastion's Prime Sentinel programming turns her on the X-Men.
In season 2, healed but scarred, Trish reports on the ruined school, on X-Factor and on Graydon Creed winning the presidency.

files.notes: Names from transcripts (springfield x-men-1992 s05e14, x-men-97-2024): 'For WJVK, this is Trish Tilby.' (Graduation Day, TAS ep 76); 'Ms. Tilby' (97 ep 5, ep 7), 'Miss Tilby' (ep 8). Her Prime Sentinel lines in ep 8 ('Don't. You'll spoil his surprise... my creator'). In season 2 she is heard reporting in eps 11, 12 and 19; the Marvel Database shows her on screen with scars in season 2. Group: WJVK is said in TAS; the Marvel Database gives 'FC News' for X-Men '97 (cited to S1E2, probably a channel logo) but I could not confirm it is said or shown, so after her Prime Sentinel service ends (Jean's collar restores the Prime Sentinels in ep 10) she is Independent from ep 11; switch to FC News if a screen check shows it. 'Prime Sentinels' is said on screen (eps 7 to 9). Compound file because she is a reporter and a victim for most of her time; S1 status left Active (she ends ep 8 as an active Prime Sentinel, shut down by Magneto's blackout).

st: David hears Marie's plan for a road trip adventure, and their first kiss drains him into a coma that sends her running from home.

files.notes: Named in the opening scene ('David?' after he collapses; transcript x-men). Marie later tells Logan 'The first boy I ever kissed ended up in a coma for three weeks', so he survives; status Active for want of a coma status. No group named: Independent.

add.k: A cage fighter who loses to Logan
st: Stu loses a cage fight to Logan in Laughlin City, then pulls a knife on him in the bar and ends up with claws at his throat.

files.notes: Named in the bar: 'You owe me some money.' 'Stu, let's not do this.' (transcript x-men). The low kick ('Don't hit him in the balls' / 'You said anything goes') and the knife come from the MCU wiki page and Rogue's 'Look out!'. No group: Independent.

add.k: A general backing Stryker's Weapon X program
st: General Munson watches Weapon X bond adamantium to Logan, then fumes when the half-billion-dollar weapon escapes.
Munson moves to shut Stryker down over his mutant son, and Stryker stabs him to death.

files.notes: Named on screen: Stryker greets 'General Munson.'; MPs later question Stryker 'in connection with the death of Gen. Munson' (transcript x-men-origins-wolverine). Lines: 'You've just spent half a billion dollars making him indestructible', 'We know about your son, Bill... You're too close to this.' Raft file: he funds and oversees the program that hunts Logan, then is Stryker's victim. Group: he oversees Weapon X (a U.S. Army link is not said on screen). The stabbing with an autopsy blade is from the MCU wiki page.

add.k: An old farmer who takes in the escaped Logan
st: Travis finds Logan naked in his barn, gives him his son's old clothes, a meal and a bed, and lets him ride his motorcycle.
Agent Zero kills Travis and his wife when he comes to their farm hunting Logan.

files.notes: His wife calls 'Travis!' (transcript x-men-origins-wolverine); the surname Hudson is never said, so n is 'Travis'. The group file 'The Hudsons' (fox-hudsons) stays, per the 8 November rule. The farm has no named group: Independent.

add.k: An East Berlin black marketeer who trades in mutants
st: Caliban sells Raven papers and passage for Kurt, and tips her off that Erik has left a trail of bodies in Poland.
En Sabah Nur comes to Caliban's place looking for the strongest mutants and takes Psylocke, who works for him.

files.notes: Says his own name throughout ('Caliban knows who you are', 'Caliban likes money', 'Caliban doesn't know you'; transcript x-men-apocalypse). A separate version from fox-caliban (Logan), which this registry keeps apart. Uses the app's group 'Caliban's business'. Left as a Compound file: he deals with Raven and never acts against the heroes.

st: In Poland, Nina asks her father about his parents, then the police take her into the woods to make him surrender.
Frightened, Nina turns the birds on the police, and an officer's arrow kills her and her mother.

files.notes: Named again and again ('Where's Nina?', 'Nina!'; transcript x-men-apocalypse). The surname Gurzsky is only heard as Erik's alias 'Henryk Gurzsky', so n is 'Nina'. Dark Phoenix only mentions her indirectly, so no step there. No group: Independent.

stages.title: The New Mutants
stages.text: Rahne tells the group that Reverend Craig beat her half to death and called her a witch. A vision of him later hunts her. When she says he is not real because she killed him, he answers that he rises again and leaves her burned.
stages.whoA: Rahne, the girl he beat, who killed him
stages.whoB: Reverend Craig, the priest who beat her

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: After Genosha, Trish finds Hank and tries to apologize, but he blames her for reporting outside his home while his friends died. She comes to the mansion to make amends, then her Prime Sentinel programming switches on and she turns on him.
stages.whoA: Hank McCoy, the X-Man she wants to make amends with
stages.whoB: Trish Tilby, a reporter he was close to

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Turned into a Prime Sentinel, Trish attacks the X-Men at the school. Wolverine takes her on and offers the Tin Woman a trip to the junkyard.
stages.whoA: Wolverine, who fights her as a Prime Sentinel
stages.whoB: Trish Tilby, a reporter turned Prime Sentinel

stages.title: X-Men (2000)
stages.text: Marie maps out a road trip adventure for her boyfriend David. Their first kiss drains the life from him as her power wakes. She later tells Logan the first boy she kissed spent three weeks in a coma.
stages.whoA: Marie, his girlfriend, whose kiss leaves him in a coma
stages.whoB: David, the first boy she kissed

stages.title: X-Men (2000)
stages.text: Stu fights Logan in the cage at Laughlin City and loses after a low kick. In the bar he demands his money back and goes for Logan with a knife, and Logan puts his claws to his throat.
stages.whoA: Logan, the cage champion who beats him
stages.whoB: Stu, a cage fighter who pulls a knife on him

stages.title: X-Men Origins: Wolverine
stages.text: General Munson oversees Stryker's Weapon X program and watches Logan's bonding, then berates him when Logan escapes. When Munson learns about Stryker's mutant son and moves to shut him down, Stryker kills him.
stages.whoA: William Stryker, the colonel running his program
stages.whoB: General Munson, the superior he murders

stages.title: X-Men Origins: Wolverine
stages.text: Travis finds the escaped Logan in his barn and takes him in with his son's old clothes, a meal and a bed. The next morning he lends Logan his motorcycle, and Agent Zero kills him and his wife.
stages.whoA: Logan, the stranger he takes in
stages.whoB: Travis, the farmer who shelters him

stages.title: X-Men Origins: Wolverine
stages.text: Agent Zero comes to Travis's farm hunting Logan. He kills Travis and his wife, then blames Logan for their deaths.
stages.whoB: Travis, a farmer he kills while hunting Logan

stages.title: X-Men: Apocalypse
stages.text: Raven, whom Caliban calls Mystique, buys papers and passage for Kurt from him in East Berlin. He gives her free news that Erik Lehnsherr has killed in Poland, which sends her to find him.
stages.whoA: Mystique, a mercenary he sells papers to
stages.whoB: Caliban, a black marketeer in East Berlin

stages.title: X-Men: Apocalypse
stages.text: Psylocke works for Caliban in East Berlin. When En Sabah Nur comes looking for the strongest mutants, he unlocks her power and she leaves with him.

stages.title: X-Men: Apocalypse
stages.text: Nina lives in Poland with her father Erik, who tells her his parents were taken from him and promises no one will take him from her. When the police come for him, her power flares and an arrow kills her and her mother.
stages.whoB: Nina, his daughter, killed by police

changes.was: David plans an adventure with Marie, and their first kiss drains him into a coma that sends her running from home.
changes.now: David hears Marie's plan for a road trip adventure, and their first kiss drains him into a coma that sends her running from home.
changes.why: Marie is the one who maps out the adventure (Niagara Falls, the Rockies, Anchorage); David only asks if it will be cold, and she answers that's the point.

changes.now: Marie maps out a road trip adventure for her boyfriend David. Their first kiss drains the life from him as her power wakes. She later tells Logan the first boy she kissed spent three weeks in a coma.
changes.why: The adventure is Marie's plan, not David's: she lays out the route and he asks whether it will be cold.
